context.source_text:
Passive cooling lab: experiment CR-04
The test compared two unoccupied model boxes in the same courtyard.
The goal was to compare afternoon air temperatures under two roof finishes.

The indoor sensor was positioned 15 cm above the base.
The two boxes each used a base measuring 40 cm by 40 cm.
The chart marks the reflective-roof series with a solid line.

At 14:00 the reflective roof box was at 31.2 degrees C and the plain roof box was at 34.8 degrees C.
The screen above both boxes was fully retracted during this reading.

For CR-04, the logger sampled air temperature every 10 minutes during the official recording window.
The data file stores timestamps in local time.
